list.title: module:command-interface

list.description: Formats command for CLI help output.

list.title: module:commands
list.description: CLI command registry with auto-discovery. Loads command modules from this directory and manages aliases.

list.description: Apply command - replaces source text with translation keys. Applies findings from report.json to source files with backup support.

list.description: Check-sync command - validates i18n file consistency. Detects missing keys, identical values, and ICU format mismatches.

list.description: Find-orphans command - detects unused translation keys. Scans source files to identify keys not referenced in code.

list.title: module:commands/version
list.description: Version command - displays package and Node.js versions.

list.description: Watch command - file system watcher for incremental extraction. Monitors source files and re-runs extraction on changes.
